tasks.title: Fix dynamic import circular dependency workaround in services
tasks.description: Multiple services use `await import('../firebase.js')` inside function bodies to avoid circular imports (firebase.js → services → firebase.js). This adds async overhead and obscures dependencies. Fix: extract shared DB helpers (dbRead, dbWrite, dbUpdate, dbRemove) into a separate `assets/src/db.js` module. Both firebase.js and services import from db.js. No circularity.
acceptanceCriteria: New file: assets/src/db.js exports dbRead, dbWrite, dbUpdate, dbRemove, dbTransaction, onValueSubscription
assets/src/firebase.js imports from db.js, re-exports + adds auth helpers
auth.service.js: static `import { dbRead, dbWrite } from '../db.js'` replaces dynamic imports
booking.service.js: static import replaces dynamic import on line 84
Zero `await import('../firebase.js')` in any service file
Vite build succeeds with no circular dependency warnings
